$description: Spacing, sizes, corners and edges. Everything on a 4px grid. Corners are square; a floating surface's top-right corner is cut.

4.$description: A label and its control; keys in a row

8.$description: Between rows and cards; icon to text in a key

12.$description: Inside a group box or row; between sections of a window

16.$description: A window's or screen's content to its edge

title-bar.$description: Window title bars; 52px on the phone (size.header-touch)

group-header.$description: The dithered strip on top of a group box

field.$description: A field's height on the desktop; in a bottom bar the field fills the bar

action-bar.$description: A window's bottom bar: the field, the keys and the primary key, flush, with a hairline above

key-depth.$description: Deprecated (Survey's key bottom edge); zero, keys are flat

cut.$description: The 45-degree cut at a floating surface's top-right corner, never on a corner that touches a screen edge

window.$description: Windows and docked panels' free top-right
